title: Wardrobe and Aftermath
author: Dominic Blackwood
blurb: Tamsin Vasquez, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
